title: galium mollugo var. rigidum
intro: Galium mollugo var. rigidum, commonly known as Rigid Bedstraw, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Galium mollugo var. rigidum are attributed to its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
